name: J&T ARCH Investments

entity_kind.quote: Fond investuje do podniků, projektů a partnerství, které skupina vybudovala v posledních 30 letech.

investor_type.quote: J&T Arch Investments je hlavní investiční platformou skupiny J&T.

aum.quote: Aktiva pod správou fondu kvalifikovaných investorů J&T Arch Investments v roce 2025 stoupla o 81,4 miliardy korun na 202,9 miliardy korun.

investments.quote: KKCG, an international investment group owned by Karel Komárek, sold a 4.27% stake in Allwyn to the Czech fund J&T Arch Investment for 500 million euros.

notes: Qualified-investor holding fund of the J&T group (managed by J&T Investiční společnost), listed on the Prague Stock Exchange; invests in large group and partner holdings (EPH, Allwyn, Moneta, EPEI preferred shares in Dec 2025), not in startups or SME rounds. Related to but distinct from J&T Ventures (c064). investor_type pe is an approximation; stages/tickets not stated.
